DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer secondary to chronic venous insufficiency.

The Doppler results confirm significant venous reflux and obstruction in your right leg, which explains the chronic swelling and the non-healing wound. Given the location, history of DVT, and family history, this is consistent with a venous stasis ulcer.
